newsitem.title: USA: BEC Group to buy back up to 10 pct of stock.
newsitem.headline: BEC Group to buy back up to 10 pct of stock.

text.p: BEC Group Inc, a sunglasses and optical technologies company, said on Tuesday it had authorized a stock repurchase program, contingent on the pending sale of the company's Foster Grant Group.
It said it would buy back up to 10 percent of its outstanding stock.
As of June 30, BEC had 17,629,000 shares outstanding.
The company said the repurchased stock would be used for its stock option and employee stock purchase plans and for prospective issuance to holders of its 8.0 percent convertible notes due 2002.
BEC Chief Executive Martin Franklin, in a telephone interview, said the company expects to sell Foster Grant to American Greeting Corp for about $50 million by the end of September.
